+
+// SnapshotForTesting captures the registry's current contents and returns a
+// function that restores it to exactly that state.
+//
+// Tests that trigger agent registration as a side effect — external-agent
+// discovery via runAgentList, for example — must defer or t.Cleanup the
+// returned restore. Otherwise mock agents backed by t.TempDir binaries leak
+// into the process-global registry and corrupt later tests in the package:

+// TempDir cleanup ordering keeps that from mis-reporting installed agents.

+	registryMu.Lock()
+	defer registryMu.Unlock()
+	snapshot := make(map[types.AgentName]Factory, len(registry))
+	maps.Copy(snapshot, registry)
+	return func() {
+		registryMu.Lock()
+		defer registryMu.Unlock()
+		registry = snapshot

+// discovery via runAgentList, for example — must defer or t.Cleanup the
+// returned restore. Otherwise mock agents backed by t.TempDir binaries leak

59	// The registry name — not Agent.Name() — is the identity users type and
60	// Get accepts; an external plugin's self-reported name can differ from the
61	// name derived from its binary, which is what it is registered under.

68	// every registered agent except the test-only ones. It is the single place the

70	// hook support or externality) get the same answer as callers that only need

74	// concurrent restore of a testing snapshot is the only way that happens) are
75	// skipped.

77		names := List()

167	// `c:\users\bob\.cursor\...` refer to the same location but would not match
